settlement_source: Official result declared by governing body of the competition; Source Agencies in hierarchy: ICC, ESPNcricinfo, relevant national board, official broadcaster
settlement_variable: Official match result of a men's Test: winner team, or Draw/Tie strike (tie, or time elapsed with no winner). 'No Result' is NOT a draw.
timezone: ET (expiration 10:00 AM ET; match start quoted in EDT)
tie_handling: Draw/Tie strike listed: Yes on tie or draw, all team strikes No. Tie with no Draw/Tie strike listed: $0.50. 'No Result' -> last fair price, not Draw/Tie.
rounding: n/a (binary); $0.50 for tie without Draw/Tie strike; tick $0.01
trading_close_vs_settlement: Listed close/expiration ~8 days after match start (sample 2026-11-03T08:30Z for match scheduled Oct 27) = placeholder; can_close_early=1; settlement_timer 240s; latest Expiration Date is 3rd day after match ends; Expiration time 10:00 AM ET.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Cancelled before commencement or abandoned before toss with no official result -> fair market price. Delayed >5 days from original start -> fair market price. Abandoned after toss -> official result. Forfeit before play -> last fair price. Kalshi may start Market Outcome Review at sole discretion (Rule 7.1). Revisions after expiration ignored.
title_vs_rules_divergences: Tie with no Draw/Tie strike pays $0.50 rather than Yes/No.
'No Result' is neither Draw nor Tie; Draw/Tie holders get last-fair-price not Yes.
Terms PDF is a generic cricket template (T20/ODI/IPL) though series is Tests only.
Rain-affected Tests commonly end in draw so team 'wins' strikes resolve No.
toxicity_flags: Live in-play outcome visible on public feeds with seconds latency; latency-driven informed flow
Draw probability drifts with weather/time; 3-way structure with discretionary $0.50 / fair-price outcomes
Close time is a placeholder (can_close_early); real halt unpredictable
Fair-price resolution at Exchange discretion on abandonment/delay
Multi-day match; stale quotes after wickets/rain delays
